parts.name: Translation
parts.Basic_description: This is the movable sash or pane section of the window, typically made of glass and supported by a lightweight frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows light to pass through and can slide vertically or horizontally to open or close the window for ventilation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves translationally within the window frame, typically sliding up and down or side to side.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the window, made of aluminum for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the movable sash, ensuring stability and alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed boundary for the moving sash.
